desc: Co-op with an idle player in the crowd (players 3 seated, as coop_audience_local): on Mario's turn an audience member winds up a throw (the script's audience_throw) and player 1's X still goes for them; 3P's own seat still emotes (X: clap) and throws after, the crowd's co-op controls as they were
